summary: US forces launched widespread strikes across southern Iran targeting missile systems, air defenses, and IRGC naval assets near the Strait of Hormuz, with explosions reported in at least 12 locations including Bandar Abbas, Ahvaz, and Qeshm. Iranian officials confirm strikes on strategic infrastructure including the Khondab nuclear site and petrochemical facilities, while CENTCOM states the operation aims to degrade Iran's ability to attack civilian shipping. Meanwhile, IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza and destroyed a weapons production site in Gaza City.
key_points: US strikes hit multiple Iranian cities including Ahvaz, Mahshahr, Sirik, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar, Bushehr, Qeshm, Jask, Minab, Bandar Kangan, Omidiyeh, and Emadshahr. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75783)
CENTCOM confirms US strikes directed at degrading Iranian ability to attack civilian ships in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @shin_persian/7729)
IRGC deputy logistics Maziyar Bobardak targeted and killed in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/7742)
Iranian naval air defense officer Hamid Reza Dehghan killed in US strike on Jask. (Source: @pkpoi/143241)
Khondab nuclear site near Arak reportedly targeted by US strikes. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75782)
IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza: Hassan Mustafa Zahir Al-Razina and Mohammad Mahmoud Abd al-Mu'ti Fayyoumi. (Source: @idf_telegram/24603)
IDF destroyed Hamas weapons production site in Gaza City where operatives were manufacturing components. (Source: @pkpoi/143244)
Drone strike hit Iranian Kurdish opposition camp in Sulaymaniyah, northern Iraq. (Source: @N12chat/217092)

sections.executive_summary: US forces launched widespread strikes across southern Iran targeting missile systems, air defenses, and IRGC naval assets near the Strait of Hormuz, with explosions reported in at least 12 locations including Bandar Abbas, Ahvaz, and Qeshm. Iranian officials confirm strikes on strategic infrastructure including the Khondab nuclear site and petrochemical facilities, while CENTCOM states the operation aims to degrade Iran's ability to attack civilian shipping. Meanwhile, IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza and destroyed a weapons production site in Gaza City.

points: US strikes struck at least 12 locations across southern Iran including Ahvaz, Mahshahr, Sirik, Bandar Abbas, Chabahar, Bushehr, Qeshm, Jask, Minab, Bandar Kangan, Omidiyeh, and Emadshahr, targeting missile systems, air defenses, and IRGC naval assets. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75783)

CENTCOM stated the strikes were directed by the Commander in Chief to degrade Iranian ability to attack civilian ships in the Strait of Hormuz, confirming targeting of missile systems, air defenses, and small IRGC boats at multiple sites around the strait. (Source: @shin_persian/7729)

IRGC deputy logistics commander Maziyar Bobardak was killed in a strike on Ahvaz in Khuzestan Province, while Iranian naval air defense officer Hamid Reza Dehghan was killed in the US strike on Jask. (Source: @shin_persian/7742, @pkpoi/143241)

The Khondab nuclear site near Arak and the heavy water reactor area were reportedly targeted again, with unverified reports of explosions near the Arak heavy water facility. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75782, @New_security8200/202494)

Petrochemical facilities in Mahshahr and strategic transport lines, ports, and vital infrastructure were hit, with the US reportedly targeting petrochemical industries and economic sites. (Source: @New_security8200/202500, @rasedal3ado138e/376652, @rasedal3ado138e/376653)

Hormozgan governor's office reported no civilian casualties or damage to residential and commercial infrastructure from the new US strikes on parts of the province. (Source: @presstv/198412, @Faytuks_Network/4883)

IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza: Hassan Mustafa Zahir Al-Razina, who attempted to plant explosive devices near the Yellow Line, and Mohammad Mahmoud Abd al-Mu'ti Fayyoumi, a Nukhba force member advancing imminent attacks on troops. (Source: @idf_telegram/24603, @manniefabian/58774)

IDF destroyed a Hamas weapons production site in Gaza City where operatives were manufacturing components for weapons, striking while several Hamas militants were inside operating the facility. (Source: @pkpoi/143244)

IDF issued a false missile attack warning to cellphones in central Israel due to a technical malfunction, confirming no security incident occurred and the event is under investigation. (Source: @idf_telegram/24601, @manniefabian/58771)
Shin Bet chief David Zini met opposition leader Yair Lapid for their first security briefing since Zini assumed office. (Source: @yediotnews25/132572, @inon_yttach/9393)

IDF eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza in separate strikes: Hassan Mustafa Zahir Al-Razina on Saturday and Mohammad Mahmoud Abd al-Mu'ti Fayyoumi on Thursday, both described as immediate threats to Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24603, @manniefabian/58774)
IDF struck and destroyed a Hamas weapons production site in Gaza City where militants were actively manufacturing weapons components in violation of the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @pkpoi/143244)
IDF Southern Command forces remain deployed in the area according to the agreement and will continue to act to remove any immediate threat. (Source: @idf_telegram/24603)
Lebanese army conducted a controlled explosion in the town of Aita al-Jabal. (Source: @redlinkleb/31018)
Hostile drone overflights continued in Lebanese airspace, with alerts urging caution. (Source: @redlinkleb/31075)

A drone strike targeted the headquarters of Iranian Kurdish opposition groups in Sulaymaniyah, northern Iraq, according to Reuters and Al Mayadeen correspondent reports. (Source: @N12chat/217092, @SharghDaily/171513)
Explosions were reported in Kuwait, with local media reporting blasts in the country. (Source: @inon_yttach/9387)
Missiles were launched from Kuwaiti territory toward the Islamic Republic of Iran, according to monitoring reports. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82592)
US strikes targeted IRGC naval assets and small boats at multiple sites around the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint for Gulf oil shipping. (Source: @shin_persian/7729)

sections.threat_assessment: The scale of US strikes across 12+ Iranian sites marks a significant escalation, directly targeting IRGC naval and missile capabilities near the Strait of Hormuz. The killing of senior IRGC logistics and naval air defense officers suggests precision targeting of command structures. Iran's reported restraint on civilian casualties may indicate deliberate US targeting choices, but the strikes on nuclear-adjacent sites (Khondab, Arak) raise risks of Iranian retaliation against US forces or Gulf shipping. Simultaneous Israeli operations in Gaza show continued pressure on Hamas reconstruction efforts.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states face direct spillover with missiles launched from Kuwait toward Iran and explosions in Kuwait, potentially drawing Kuwait into the conflict. Lebanese airspace sees continued Israeli drone overflights, while Iraqi territory hosts strikes on Iranian-backed groups. The death of pro-strike Senator Lindsey Graham removes a key congressional advocate for military action against Iran, possibly affecting future US political support for sustained operations.
sections.intelligence_notes: The coordination between US strikes on Iranian maritime capabilities and Israeli strikes on Hamas weapons production suggests a broader campaign to degrade Iranian proxy capabilities across multiple theaters. The targeting of Khondab nuclear site again indicates persistent focus on Iran's nuclear infrastructure. Reports of missiles from Kuwait require verification of launch platform and authorization. The false alarm in central Israel highlights civil defense readiness amid heightened tensions.
